ayahs.1: Ae woh logo jo imaan laaye ho! Mere aur (khud) apne dushmanon ko apna dost na banaao tum to dosti se un ki taraf paighaam bhejte ho aur woh is haq ke saath jo tumhare paas aa chuka hai kufr karte hain, Paighambar ko aur khud tumhein bhi mehaz is wajah se jila-watan karte hain ke tum apne Rabb par imaan rakhte ho, agar tum meri raah mein jihaad ke liye aur meri raza-mandi ki talab mein nikalte ho (to un se dostiyan na karo), tum un ke paas mohabbat ka paighaam posheeda posheeda bhejte ho aur mujhe khoob maloom hai jo tum ne chhupaaya aur woh bhi jo tum ne zaahir kiya, tum mein se jo bhi is kaam ko karega woh yaqeenan raah-e-raast se behak jaayega.
ayahs.2: Agar woh tum par kahin qaaboo paa len to woh tumhare (khule) dushman ho jaayen aur buraai ke saath tum par dast-daraazee aur zabaan-daraazee karne lagen aur (dil se) chaahne lagen ke tum bhi kufr karne lag jaao.
ayahs.3: Tumhari qaraabatein, rishtedariyan, aur aulaad tumhein qayamat ke din kaam na aayengi, Allah Taala tumhare darmiyan faisla kar dega aur jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho ise Allah khoob dekh raha hai.
ayahs.4: (Musalmano!) Tumhare liye Hazrat Ibraheem mein aur un ke saathiyon mein behtareen namoona hai, jabke un sab ne apni qaum se bar-malaa keh diya ke hum tum se aur jin jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibaadat karte ho un sab se bilkul bezaar hain. Hum tumhare (aqaaid ke) munkir hain jab tak tum Allah ki wahdaaniyat par imaan na laao hum mein tum mein hamesha ke liye bughz-o-adaawat zaahir ho gayi lekin Ibraheem ki itni baat to apne baap se hui thi ke main tumhare liye istighfaar zaroor karunga aur tumhare liye mujhe Allah ke saamne kisi cheez ka ikhtiyaar kuchh bhi nahin. Ae hamare Parwardigaar tujhi par hum ne bharosa kiya hai aur teri hi taraf ruju karte hain aur teri hi taraf lautna hai.
ayahs.5: Ae hamare Rabb! Tu hamein kaafiron ki aazmaaish mein na daal aur ae hamare paalne wale hamari khataaon ko bakhsh de, beshak tu hi Ghaalib, Hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.6: Yaqeenan tumhare liye un mein achha namoona (aur umda pairwi hai khaas kar) har is shakhs ke liye jo Allah ki aur qayamat ke din ki mulaaqaat ki umeed rakhta ho, aur agar koi roogardaani kare to Allah Taala bilkul be-niyaaz hai aur sazaawaar-e-hamd-o-sanaa hai.
ayahs.7: Kya ajab ke anqareeb hi Allah Taala tum mein aur tumhare dushmanon mein mohabbat paida kar de. Allah ko sab qudratein hain aur Allah (bada) Ghafoor Raheem hai.
ayahs.8: Jin logon ne tum se deen ke baare mein ladaai nahin ladi aur tumhein jila-watan nahin kiya un ke saath sulook-o-ehsaan karne aur munsifaana bhale bartaao karne se Allah Taala tumhein nahin rokta, balke Allah Taala to insaaf karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
ayahs.9: Allah Taala tumhein sirf un logon ki mohabbat se rokta hai jinhon ne tum se deen ke baare mein ladaaiyan ladin aur tumhein shehar se nikaal diye aur shehar se nikaalne walon ki madad ki jo log aise kuffaar se mohabbat karen woh (qat'an) zaalim hain.
ayahs.10: Ae imaan walo! Jab tumhare paas momin auratein hijrat karke aayen to tum un ka imtihaan lo. Darasal un ke imaan ko bakhoobi jaanne wala to Allah hi hai lekin agar woh tumhein imaan waaliyan maloom hon to ab tum unhein kaafiron ki taraf waapas na karo, yeh un ke liye halaal nahin aur na woh un ke liye halaal hain, aur jo kharch un kaafiron ka hua ho woh unhein ada kar do, un auraton ko un ke mehr de kar un se nikaah kar lene mein tum par koi gunaah nahin aur kaafir auraton ki naamoos apne qabza mein na rakho aur jo kuchh tum ne kharch kiya ho, maang lo aur jo kuchh un kaafiron ne kharch kiya ho woh bhi maang len yeh Allah ka faisla hai jo tumhare darmiyan kar raha hai, Allah Taala bade ilm (aur) Hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.11: Aur agar tumhari koi biwi tumhare haath se nikal jaaye aur kaafiron ke paas chali jaaye phir tumhein is ke badle ka waqt mil jaaye to jin ki biwiyan chali gayi hain unhein un ke ikhrajat ke baraabar ada kar do, aur is Allah Taala se darte raho jis par tum imaan rakhte ho.
ayahs.12: Ae Paighambar! Jab musalman auratein Aap se un baaton par baiat karne aayen ke woh Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karengi, chori na karengi, zina-kaari na karengi, apni aulaad ko na maar daalengi aur koi aisa bohtan na baandhengi jo khud apne haathon pairon ke saamne ghad len aur kisi nek kaam mein teri be-hukmee na karengi to Aap un se baiat kar liya karein, aur un ke liye Allah se maghfirat talab karein beshak Allah Taala bakhshne aur maaf karne wala hai.
ayahs.13: Ae Musalmano! Tum is qaum se dosti na rakho jin par Allah ka ghazab naazil ho chuka hai jo aakhirat se is tarah mayoos ho chuke hain jaise ke murda Ahl-e-Qabr se kaafir na-umeed hain.
